newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb wounds Israeli soldier in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds Israeli soldier in south Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was wounded on Wednesday by a roadside bomb in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

They said the bomb went off near an Israeli patrol on the road to Arnoun in the central sector of the Israeli occupation zone in south Lebanon, wounding one soldier who was taken to Israel by a helicopter.

Last Thursday pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven in a fierce clash in south Lebanon. Israeli aircraft launched several attacks on south Lebanon over the next three days.
Moslem guerrillas attack Israeli forces and their militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15 km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone in south Lebanon.
